messages:
Lina (AE): Heads-up team — BridgePay sent a 102-question RFI + capability matrix. They want technical answers, security questionnaire, a 3-week POC SOW, and pricing bands for Dedicated vs Private. Uploaded: /shared/bridgepay/rfi/bridgepay_rfi_v1.xlsx. Deadline EOD next Friday. Can we split?

Owen (SE): Ill take the capability matrix and throughput estimates. Quick clarifying Q: they asked about int4 support and deterministic output enforcement for compliance workflows.

Lina (AE): Yes — int4 mentioned for latency-sensitive fraud scoring, and they want deterministic structured outputs for downstream KYB ingestion.

Gwen (Security): I'll own the security sheet. Looks like BYOK/HSM, PCI, export controls, and a provenance/redaction row. I'll draft standard answers and flag legal items.

Marco (Sales): Ill sketch pricing and the POC commercial. Need Owen's QPS/token table to size Dedicated pools and burst. Also include optional on-site audit pricing.

Owen (SE): Draft technical notes to use in matrix: "Quantization (int8/int4): Supported on Dedicated and Private with validated runtime profiles; Hosted may offer select quantized variants per model. Deterministic/structured outputs & function calling: Supported on Hosted and Dedicated; Private supports it with runtime >=2.1 and control-plane egress allowlist. Edge shards/local inference: supported in Private under an ops integration with network ACLs and local KV cache."

Gwen (Security): Sample security answers: TLS1.2+ (TLS1.3 preferred), AES-256 at rest, tenant-scoped logs, RBAC & SSO support, BYOK via cloud KMS and on-prem HSM appliances for Private. For PCI: "We support PCI-compliant deployment patterns (Private/Dedicated); formal attestation requires a scoped engagement." Flagging PCI attestation and export control Qs for Harper.

Harper (Legal): On it. For escrow/model weights requests, we usually offer an escrow schedule under NDA and fees. For indemnity/model-license asks, add: "Subject to third-party model vendor terms; Redwood will coordinate but cannot provide vendor indemnities without separate agreement."

Lina (AE): POC SOW sketch: "Week 0: infra prep (VPC peering, IAM, KMS proof-of-concept); Week 1: ingest + perf baselines (embedding vs gen); Week 2: security & provenance tests, optional Private smoke with BYOK/HSM; Week 3: runbook, perf report, recommendations." Marco, include pricing ranges per week.

Marco (Sales): Will do. POC commercial: 3-week Dedicated baseline + optional Private trial week. Baseline includes reserved pool + support hours; add-ons: HSM integration, on-site audit, escrow fee. I'll draft numeric ranges after Owen's sizing.

Owen (SE): Quick throughput est from their sample profile (75% embeds @ ~256 tokens, 25% gen @ ~1k tokens): 100 QPS -> ~35k tks/s; 500 QPS -> ~175k tks/s; 1000 QPS -> ~350k tks/s. I'll attach a small table in the matrix.

Gwen (Security): Logging Qs: "Where are logs stored and who can access them?" Draft answer: "Private: logs remain in customer environment. Hosted/Dedicated: tenant-scoped logs, access limited to authorized ops/support with audited approvals; optional export to customer S3/GCS."

Lina (AE): They also want a short SLA blurb for Dedicated with burst behavior. Owen, can you paste a sentence?

Owen (SE): SLA blurb: "Redwood Dedicated: 99.95% availability for reserved pools. Burst capacity is best-effort and subject to regional availability; automatic fallback to a compatible model variant or alternate region is available and configurable. Customers may pin model versions to prevent fallback for strict SLA needs."

Marco (Sales): Attachments to prepare: capability_matrix_bridgepay.xlsx (Owen), security_answers_bridgepay.docx (Gwen), poc_sow_bridgepay.pdf (Marco), pricing_ranges_bridgepay.csv (Marco). Upload path?

Lina (AE): Use /shared/bridgepay/rfi/submission_v1/. Ill zip and submit after approvals.

drive-bot: Folder snapshot created: https://drive.internal/s/bridgepay/rfi/submission_v1/ :white_check_mark:

Gwen (Security): Timeline: I'll have the security draft by Wed 3pm PT with legal flags inline. Owen: can you have the capability matrix by Wed noon? Marco: pricing by Wed 5pm? Lina will consolidate Thu morning.

Owen (SE): Matrix first pass by Wed 11am PT.

Marco (Sales): Pricing + POC by Wed 5pm PT.

Harper (Legal): I'll review flags Wed 6pm PT and draft escalations for escrow and PCI wording.

Lina (AE): Thanks team. If anything high-risk appears, call it out here and tag @Harper. I'll assemble the draft submission and run it by Legal before we send. :thumbsup:
